description: This Java class 'EntityTypeUtil' provides utility methods for handling entity types, including checking type hierarchies, retrieving descendant types, and verifying parent types within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityTypeUtil
classes.description: A utility class for managing entity type hierarchies and relationships within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: isType
methods.description: Checks if any element in a collection of GenericValue objects is related to a target type via a specified relation.

methods.name: getParentType
methods.description: Retrieves the parent type of a given type value based on a naming convention.

methods.name: getDescendantTypes
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all descendant types of a given type value.

methods.name: isType
methods.description: Determines if a type is a descendant of another type by traversing the parent hierarchy.

methods.name: hasParentType
methods.description: Checks if a specific type has a particular parent type in the hierarchy, querying the database.
